definitions.explanation: The rotating shaft that transmits power from an engine or motor to the wheels or to a driven part of a machine. In a car it carries the engine's torque to the wheels that propel the vehicle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{駆動軸|くどうじく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{折|お}れた→折れる：01266_oreru⟧。
⟦エンジン→エンジン：03835_enjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{駆動軸|くどうじく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦タイヤ→タイヤ：06330_taiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}わる→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: The engine's power is transmitted to the tires through the drive shaft.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{駆動軸|くどうじく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: This machine's whole mechanism moves through the rotation of the drive shaft.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{駆動|くどう}→駆動：24244_kudou⟧ (driving, actuation) + ⟦{軸|じく}→軸：14304_jiku⟧ (shaft, axle). A standard term in automotive and mechanical engineering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆動軸|くどうじく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to turn the drive shaft
- {前輪|ぜんりん}{駆動軸|くどうじく}: front drive shaft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{車軸|しゃじく}→車軸：25001_shajiku⟧: axle — the shaft on which a wheel turns, whether or not it delivers power.
- {回転軸|かいてんじく}: axis of rotation — any shaft or axis about which something rotates.
